# PRD — Legacy Format

## Project Requirements

### PR-PROJ-001: Ship The Feature

| Aspect | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Description | The feature delivers the core business capability. |
| User Story | As a developer, I want to invoke the capability. |
| In Scope | The core happy path. |
| Out of Scope | Third-party integrations. |
| Success Metric | Zero runtime panics in production. |
